baseline_prompt_en: A high-energy editorial photograph of an unmistakably adult bunny-girl performer seated in the center position of the rear bench seat in a moving compact van. She is visibly in her mid-twenties, with mature facial structure and adult proportions. She wears a sleek black satin bunny suit, opaque tights, a white collar, wrist cuffs, and tall rabbit ears. Her shoulders and hips rest against the rear backrest as she leans comfortably backward, with the center three-point seat belt crossing her torso. She raises both hands beside her cheeks, each hand forming a clear V sign with separated index and middle fingers, creating a symmetrical double-peace pose. Her expression is an exaggerated overwhelmed display: eyes visibly rolled upward and slightly crossed, tongue extended, cheeks flushed, and mouth open in theatrical happiness. Photograph her from the front-center aisle looking back toward the rear bench, with her face, both hands, reclined posture, and central seating position fully visible. Through both side windows, streaked roadside lights and directional motion blur establish that the van is traveling at speed, while direct on-camera flash keeps the passenger, seat belt, upholstery, and costume sharply frozen. Use a close wide-angle documentary-fashion aesthetic, centered depth composition, crisp skin texture, glossy fabric highlights, and playful nightlife energy.
